Accessibility

Built for clear access.

This site aims for readable content, meaningful structure, keyboard access, responsive layouts, and reduced-motion support.

Current commitments

The site uses semantic landmarks, visible keyboard focus, a skip link, clear heading structure, responsive content, and status labels that are not communicated through color alone.

If you find an accessibility barrier, please use the GitHub profile linked on the contact page to report it.
